title.zh: Canton拟最早11月2日上线代币化美股交易，有望成SEC新规下首例
title.en: Canton拟最早11月2日上线代币化美股交易，有望成SEC新规下首例

current_state.zh: Canton Strategic Holdings agreed with the licensed Canton-based platform TSV to offer issuer-sponsored tokenized shares of its own Nasdaq-listed common stock, targeting a launch as early as Nov 2 and billing it as the first compliant onshore tokenized US equity under the SEC's innovation exemption framework.
current_state.en: Canton Strategic Holdings agreed with the licensed Canton-based platform TSV to offer issuer-sponsored tokenized shares of its own Nasdaq-listed common stock, targeting a launch as early as Nov 2 and billing it as the first compliant onshore tokenized US equity under the SEC's innovation exemption framework.
